resources.string: Rules clean candidate entries shown by Android or apps. In Hide selected mode, checking an entry hides it; in Show selected only mode, checked entries are kept. Rules do not set defaults, uninstall apps, or disable components. Real component enable/disable is handled separately on the Root Components page.

Advanced entries only filter candidate discovery where the caller is an ordinary app. System and privileged UID queries are left unchanged for safety. Selecting an item does not grant or revoke permissions, enable or disable the service, or make another item the system default.
Apps and components offered for normal ACTION_SEND sharing. Selecting hides or keeps the chooser entry only; the target app is unchanged.
Apps and components offered when sharing multiple items with ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE. This is managed separately from normal single-item sharing.

Recently observed Direct Share contacts, conversations, or sharing shortcuts shown at the top of the Android share sheet. Selecting hides that target from the chooser; contacts and conversations are not deleted.
Apps handling SENDTO links such as mailto: and smsto:. Useful for cleaning mail and messaging choices that are not ordinary Open candidates.
Open-with candidates for files, MIME types, schemes, and configured file types. Selecting changes only which matching entries are presented.
Browser candidates for HTTP and HTTPS links. This filters browser choices; it does not change Android's current default browser.
App handlers for configured web/deep links. Rules can hide or keep matching app entries without changing the app's verified-link state.
Apps offered for ACTION_DIAL / tel: links. Filtering candidates does not change the current default dialer.
Apps offered for ACTION_GET_CONTENT when an app asks the user to choose content. Storage providers inside the system document picker are managed separately.
Handlers for ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT. This cleans the outer document-opening candidates; storage locations inside DocumentsUI are managed under Storage locations.
Handlers for ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT when saving or creating a document. It does not choose or change the default save location.
Camera or capture apps offered for ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE. Selecting only filters the capture chooser entry.
Camera or video apps offered for ACTION_VIDEO_CAPTURE. Selecting only filters the capture chooser entry.
Recorder apps offered for the standard record-sound Intent. Selecting only filters the chooser entry.
Apps and activities offered for selected-text actions such as translate, search, or process text. Text-processing lists are allowed to become empty.
Apps returned for the HOME launcher Intent. This manages HOME candidates only and does not change the launcher currently set as Android's default.
Apps returned for the assistant Intent. This manages assistant candidates only and does not change the system's selected default assistant or voice service.
App-level long-press shortcut sources associated with launcher activities. Use this to hide an app's shortcut surface as a group without disabling the app.
Individual manifest, dynamic, or pinned ShortcutInfo entries observed at runtime. Selecting hides the observed shortcut from supported query surfaces; the underlying shortcut data is not deleted.
Storage Access Framework DocumentsProvider entries such as cloud drives, file managers, or NAS providers. Hiding an entry does not unmount storage or delete files.
InputMethodService candidates discovered through PackageManager. This does not enable, disable, or switch the current keyboard.
AutofillService candidates. Filtering discovery does not enable/disable Autofill and does not change the currently selected Autofill service.
Credential, password, and passkey provider services. Rules do not delete saved passwords/passkeys or change the active credential provider.
NotificationListenerService candidates. This does not grant or revoke Notification Access; it only affects supported candidate discovery.
AccessibilityService candidates. This does not turn an accessibility service on or off and does not change its granted state.
VpnService candidates. This does not connect, disconnect, authorize, or set a default VPN.
PrintService candidates. Filtering does not enable/disable print services or change printer configuration.
Live WallpaperService candidates. This does not apply, remove, or change the current wallpaper.
DreamService / screensaver candidates. This does not enable screensaver mode or choose the active screensaver.
Host/off-host NFC card-emulation service candidates. This does not change AIDs, payment defaults, NFC routing, or enable/disable the service.
CallScreeningService candidates. This does not grant the call-screening role, enable call blocking, or change the current phone role.
